what: The report called the models' self-test counter "утверждений" (assertions). The code documents it as states checked, so the unit of measure was mislabelled.
found_by: reading the live output of seqtest.mjs against the source of models.mjs, not by re-reading the report: models.mjs:15 states "model.selfTest() -> number   states checked, throws on an internal contradiction" and models.mjs:971 "Returns {dffe, ram4, mem4x8, lpm_ram_dq} in states checked".

live_confirmation.seqtest_own_assertions: RESULT: PASS - 84 assertions - these are the 84 named assertions of seqtest.mjs, a DIFFERENT and much smaller count, which is exactly why conflating the two units matters

false_start_recorded: my first attempt to re-verify the foundation was `node lab13/models.mjs --selftest`, which printed nothing and exited 0: models.mjs has no CLI entry, so the flag was ignored and the run was a no-op. Reporting that EXIT=0 as confirmation would have been exactly the substitution of a green code for a measurement, so it was chased down instead: the real entry is seqtest.mjs, which calls runAllSelfTests() at line 468 and selfTestNotes() at line 477.

secondary_defects_found_by_readback: the first repair created a zeugma: "проверила 1,229,701 состояний и один перебор" makes "перебор" a second object of "проверила", which is not sensible; repaired by adding the own verb "и выполнен".
the first repair left an elliptical "то одна сверка" where "то есть одна сверка" is required.
both were caught only by reading the rendered sentence whole, which is the argument for making read-back a step rather than a spot check.
